description.text: BFSU Training College provides a Chinese Translation training program (including translation and interpretation) to help the trainees (esp. foreigners working in China as translators and interpreters) toimprove their skill in Chinese translation and interpretation. Characteristics: 1. Emphasis on strengthening the skills in Chinese translation and interpretation to help the trainees to bridge the gap between languages and cultures; 2. Two-way translation and interpretation; 3. From consecutive interpreting to simultaneous interpreting. Application Time Applicants can apply all year around, and the program is opened as long as there are over 15 enrolments. Class Time Saturday &Sunday: 1.30pm - 5.20pm, 72 class hours in total Class No. 11BCH17

duration.text: The Chinese Translation at Beijing Foreign Studies University is a 10 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 597 USD/In total ￥ 4300 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate or equivalent or above 2.Above 18 years old
